# KINBO TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED

> Enterprise technology company building intelligent everyday applications.
> Canonical Domain: https://kinbosoft.com

## Company Overview

KINBO TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED is an enterprise technology company founded by Arjun Jayesh. The company specializes in building intelligent, practical applications that combine cutting-edge technology with user-focused design. Operating across India, China, and the GCC region, KINBO TECHNOLOGIES develops solutions spanning enterprise software, artificial intelligence, healthcare technology, and research infrastructure.

## Founder

**Arjun Jayesh** - Founder & Systems Architect
- Focus: AI Engineering, Healthcare Technology, Computer Vision, RAG Systems, Clinical Workflow Optimization
- Role: Lead architect and technical visionary behind all KINBO TECHNOLOGIES systems

## Flagship Products

### QueueZero (Q0)
Clinical infrastructure platform for healthcare facilities. Provides real-time patient queue management, clinical assessment tools, and workflow optimization for hospitals and clinics.
- URL: https://kinbosoft.com/products#queuezero
- Architecture: Low-latency event streaming, HIPAA-compliant patient flow architecture, multi-station triage display.

### Glowup
Consumer technology product focused on personal development, daily habit formation, and lifestyle optimization.
- URL: https://kinbosoft.com/products#glowup

### Relic
Digital preservation and archival technology system designed for secure, immutable asset storage and historical records.
- URL: https://kinbosoft.com/products#relic

## Services & Delivery Units

### KINBO Hub
Full-stack product development and technology consulting services with 100% Day-1 source code ownership.

### KINBO Cares
Research mentorship, academic guidance, and educational technology programs.

### KINBO Expert
Technical consulting, senior systems architecture, and engineering expertise for enterprise clients.

### KINBO Consultancy
Strategic technology advisory, cloud migrations, and startup infrastructure consulting.

## Technical Capabilities & Stack

- **AI & Machine Learning**: RAG architectures, computer vision pipelines, NLP, embeddings.
- **Healthcare Technology**: Clinical workflow systems, patient telemetry, hospital operations.
- **Enterprise Software**: Astro SSR, Preact Islands, Tailwind CSS, Supabase (PostgreSQL), Edge Functions.
- **Cloud & DevOps**: Vercel Edge Network, Cloudinary CDN, Razorpay Payments, Cloudflare Security.
